title: Weak Solutions and Inertial Limits for Quasi-static Filtrations
summary: A quasi-static filtration system, comprising a poroelastic solid coupled to an incompressible free-flow, is considered in 3D. Across a flat 2D interface, the Beavers-Joseph-Saffman coupling conditions are taken. The system constitutes a doubly elliptic-parabolic coupling and can be seen as a degenerate case of the inertial Biot-Stokes dynamics. These dynamics cannot be easily recovered by simply sending the inertial parameters to zero; however, inserting a viscoelastic regularization of the inertial Biot system allows us to construct weak solutions in the inertial limit.
